vehicleDetails.title: Rizta Z
vehicleDetails.description:
The Ather Rizta Z is the premium, feature-loaded sibling in the Rizta family. While it shares the same "family-first" comfortable ergonomics, massive storage, and robust build as the Rizta S, the Z variant introduces a more sophisticated digital cockpit and enhanced connectivity options. It is designed for families who want a premium, high-tech riding experience without compromising on utility.

Ather Rizta Z Lineup Overview

Detailed Breakdown

  • Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh): This variant combines the premium features of the Z series with a more compact battery setup. It is ideal for those who want the full suite of "Z-series" technology—including the interactive dashboard—for routine city commuting.
  • Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh): This flagship configuration ensures you get both the premium tech experience and maximum range. It is the perfect choice for families who need the extra daily distance capacity and want the best features Ather offers in this segment.

Why the Ather Rizta Z is Best for You?

The Rizta Z takes the comfort of the "S" model and elevates it with premium "Pro Pack" features, making it the most well-rounded electric family scooter.

  • Premium Interactive Cockpit: The Rizta Z upgrades from the LCD screen to a full-color 7-inch TFT touchscreen dashboard. This enables an interactive experience with integrated Google Maps, music control, and extensive ride analytics.
  • Enhanced Comfort: Unlike the S variant, the Rizta Z comes standard with a pillion backrest, significantly improving comfort and security for family members riding on the back.
  • Advanced Smart Features: Through the Pro Pack, the Rizta Z gains features like MagicTwist™ (for regenerative braking control without using the brakes), AutoHold™ (for effortless starts on inclines), and Ping My Scooter (to help locate your vehicle in a crowded parking lot).
  • Utility & Safety: It retains the signature 56 liters of storage (34L boot + 22L optional frunk), along with advanced safety features like FallSafe™, Emergency Stop Signal (ESS), and Skid Control, ensuring that your family remains safe while traveling in comfort.

variantData.title: Rizta Z - 2.9 kWh
variantData.description:
The Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) is designed for families who want to elevate their daily commute with a touch of premium luxury. While it shares the highly efficient, city-focused battery of the base model, it completely upgrades the cabin experience. By introducing a vibrant touchscreen display and dedicated passenger comfort features, this variant proves that you do not need to buy the largest battery pack to enjoy Ather's high-end build quality and premium aesthetics. It is the perfect daily workhorse dressed in flagship hardware.

Key Performance & Premium Features

  • City-Optimized Range: Powered by the reliable 2.9 kWh Lithium-ion battery, it delivers a highly capable IDC (Indian Driving Cycle) range of 123 km. This is perfectly scaled for daily office commutes, school drops, and local errands without carrying unnecessary weight.
  • TFT Touchscreen Interface: The biggest upgrade is the dashboard. The Rizta Z replaces the standard LCD with a brilliant 7-inch TFT Touchscreen. It brings a premium, smartphone-like visual interface to your daily ride, completely transforming the look and feel of the cockpit.
  • Enhanced Pillion Comfort: Built around the class-leading 900mm long seat, the Z variant exclusively adds a dedicated pillion backrest. This ensures that passengers experience maximum safety and comfort during long city rides.
  • Smooth & Capable Powertrain: It utilizes a 4.3 kW PMSM motor producing 22 Nm of torque. This provides incredibly smooth, linear acceleration (0-40 km/h in 4.7 seconds) and a safe, comfortable top speed of 80 km/h.
  • Massive Utility: It retains the cavernous 34-liter under-seat boot, easily accommodating full-face helmets, backpacks, and the family's daily groceries.

Where Does the Rizta Z Fit?

The Ather Rizta family offers diverse configurations. Here is how the premium Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) compares to its closest relatives to help you choose the right fit for your family.

1. Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta S (2.9 kWh): The Comfort & Display Upgrade

If you know you want the 2.9 kWh battery, this comparison determines your cabin experience.

  • Shared Endurance: Both models share the exact same 2.9 kWh battery (123 km IDC range) and the smooth 4.3 kW motor.
  • The "Z" Factor: The Ather Rizta S (2.9 kWh) uses a physical DeepView™ LCD screen and a standard long seat. The Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) elevates the experience with a full-color TFT Touchscreen and adds a premium pillion backrest for enhanced passenger comfort.
  • Verdict: Choose the Rizta S for maximum practicality on a strict budget. Upgrade to the Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) if you prefer a modern, interactive touchscreen interface and frequently ride with a passenger who needs back support.

2. Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh): The Software Advantage

This comparison is for buyers who want the premium touchscreen but are debating the software capabilities.

  • Hardware Parity: Both scooters are physically identical, featuring the premium TFT Touchscreen, the pillion backrest, and the 123 km range battery.
  • The Pro Pack Difference: The standard Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) offers a basic digital experience on the touchscreen. Upgrading to the Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) fully unlocks the screen—giving you integrated Google Maps navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, advanced SkidControl™ (traction control), and the highly convenient AutoHold™ (hill assist).
  • Verdict: If you just want the premium look of the touchscreen, the standard Rizta Z is excellent. If you want that screen to act like a smart device with navigation and advanced safety features, you must opt for the Pro variant.

3. Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh): The Range Extension

Comparing this model to its bigger sibling highlights the difference in physical endurance.

  • Shared Luxury: Both the 2.9 kWh and 3.7 kWh "Z" variants share the exact same premium features: the TFT Touchscreen, the pillion backrest, and massive storage.
  • The Battery Gap: The Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) provides a highly capable city range of 123 km. The Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) utilizes the flagship battery, pushing that range up to a massive 159 km IDC.
  • Verdict: The 2.9 kWh model is perfect for standard, predictable daily routes. However, if your family travels long distances or you want the peace of mind of less frequent charging, the 3.7 kWh variant is the necessary upgrade.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh)?

The Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) is the perfect balance of luxury and daily practicality. It allows you to invest your budget directly into the features you interact with most—the premium TFT touchscreen and the passenger backrest—without forcing you to pay for a massive battery pack you may not need for a 15 km daily commute. It is the smartest way to get flagship-level comfort for your family's everyday journeys.

variantData.title: Rizta Z - 3.7 kWh
variantData.description:
The Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) is the absolute crown jewel of Ather's family-focused electric scooter lineup. Designed explicitly for space, comfort, and maximum endurance, this top-tier variant combines an expansive seating arrangement with Ather's largest battery pack. It takes the stress out of daily family commutes by offering a massive driving range, advanced touchscreen technology, and safety features that make every ride smooth, secure, and highly connected.

Key Performance & Specifications

  • Maximum Family Range: Powered by the larger 3.7 kWh Lithium-ion battery, this variant delivers an outstanding IDC (Indian Driving Cycle) range of 159 km. This ensures that multiple school runs, grocery trips, and long commutes can be completed comfortably on a single charge.
  • Smooth & Safe Performance: It utilizes a 4.3 kW PMSM motor with 22 Nm of torque, tuned specifically for smooth and linear acceleration. It reaches a top speed of 80 km/h and features advanced SkidControl™ technology to prevent wheel slip on wet or gravelly roads.
  • Premium Tech Interface: The Rizta Z features a vibrant 17.7 cm (7-inch) TFT Touchscreen dashboard. It comes with built-in Google Maps for seamless turn-by-turn navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, smart ride stats, and WhatsApp integration.
  • Massive Utility & Comfort: It boasts one of the largest seats in the segment, accompanied by a comfortable pillion backrest. For cargo, it offers a cavernous 34-liter boot space (expandable up to 56L with the optional Frunk) and features the highly convenient AutoHold™ function for stability on inclines.

Variant Comparison: Choosing Your Ather Rizta

The Ather Rizta family offers different configurations based on your daily travel distance and technology needs. Here is how the flagship Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) compares to its siblings.

1. Ather Rizta Z 3.7 kWh VS Ather Rizta Z 2.9 kWh: The Endurance Upgrade

If you want all the premium features but are deciding on battery size, this is the key comparison.

  • Shared Luxury: Both the 2.9 kWh and 3.7 kWh "Z" variants share the exact same premium features: the 7-inch TFT Touchscreen, Google Maps integration, SkidControl™, and the pillion backrest.
  • The Range Difference: The Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) provides a highly capable IDC range of 123 km. The Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) upgrades you to a massive 159 km IDC range, offering over 30 km of extra driving distance per charge.
  • Verdict: Choose the Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) if your daily city commutes are predictable and under 40 km. Choose the Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) if you frequently travel longer distances, ride with a heavy payload (pillion + cargo), or simply want the peace of mind of charging less often.

2. Ather Rizta Z 3.7 kWh VS Ather Rizta S 2.9 kWh: The Ultimate Step-Up

The Ather Rizta S (2.9 kWh) is the entry-level model of the Rizta family.

  • Technology Gap: The Rizta S utilizes a simpler 7-inch DeepView™ LCD display with basic navigation and misses out on advanced traction features like SkidControl™. The Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) offers the full premium TFT Touchscreen with Google Maps and the enhanced safety suite.
  • Endurance & Battery: The Rizta S is restricted to the smaller 2.9 kWh battery (123 km IDC range). The Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) gives you the flagship 3.7 kWh battery, pushing your range to 159 km.
  • Verdict: The Ather Rizta S (2.9 kWh) is a fantastic, no-nonsense budget option for families. However, if you want the absolute best range, the safest traction technology, and a premium touchscreen experience, the Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) is the definitive choice.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh)?

The Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) is the ultimate uncompromising family scooter. It addresses the two biggest concerns of modern EV buyers: range anxiety and passenger comfort. By combining a class-leading 159 km range with a massive seat, a 34L trunk, and the intelligent SkidControl™ safety system, it provides a premium, stress-free riding experience for the entire family.
